name: moodly-video
description: Vidéo de présentation de Moodly (Remotion + three.js), écrans capturés dans la vraie app

scripts.render:16x9: remotion render Moodly16x9 out/moodly-16x9-4k.mp4 --scale=2 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/moodly-16x9-4k.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 14 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/moodly-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:9x16: remotion render Moodly9x16 out/moodly-9x16-4k.mp4 --scale=2 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/moodly-9x16-4k.mp4 -vf scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 14 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/moodly-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:30s:16x9: remotion render Moodly30s16x9 out/moodly-30s-16x9-4k.mp4 --scale=2 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/moodly-30s-16x9-4k.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 14 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/moodly-30s-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:30s:9x16: remotion render Moodly30s9x16 out/moodly-30s-9x16-4k.mp4 --scale=2 && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/moodly-30s-9x16-4k.mp4 -vf scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 14 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/moodly-30s-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:30s: npm run render:30s:16x9 && npm run render:30s:9x16
scripts.render: npm run render:16x9 && npm run render:9x16
